provider_impact.missing_contract: The future binder/provider tests must prove that the second system message remains the exact ExperienceFrameSet canonical serialization, that no frame is flattened/merged/overwritten, and that a real ModelProvider transport forwards those exact envelope messages.

model_visible_multi_experience_encoding.decision_basis: The approved carrier architecture names ExperienceFrameSet as the model-visible carrier. The existing binder already owns deterministic canonical JSON, and the provider envelope already transports opaque exact semantic bytes. A single ordered frame-set system unit preserves every individual frame more exactly than splitting into provider-specific messages.
